name: HookShot Effects
description: The HookShot's look and sound on everyone's screen: the Printer it is built from recast as a temple relic of weathered bronze, carved glyph rings and gold filigree with a teal eye-stone that wakes while the chain is out; a gold-bronze spearhead whose barbed claws spring out to bite, riding along on players and vehicles; a chain of interlocking bronze links that runs back into the barrel as it hauls you in; and sounds for shooting, biting, hauling and letting go.
